whatIs.title: An AI operating system where <accent>every decision is visible</accent>
whatIs.description: Unlike black-box AI, Liwaisi Assistant uses a Coloured Petri Net engine to orchestrate AI workflows with mathematical precision. Every token of data, every transition, every decision — visible and auditable in real time. Your team stays in control at every step.

transparent.title: Transparent
transparent.description: See every step of every workflow. No hidden prompts, no mystery reasoning.

auditable.title: Auditable
auditable.description: Every execution is recorded. Full cost tracking, token usage, and decision history.

humanFirst.title: Human-First
humanFirst.description: AI proposes, you decide. Approve, reject, or revise at any critical point.

howItWorks.title: From request to result, <accent>every step visible</accent>

step01.title: You make a request
step01.subtitle: Place: Surface Space
step01.description: Your input enters the system as a colored token in the Surface space — the human-facing boundary where you maintain full control.

step02.title: AI agents analyze and draft
step02.subtitle: Transition: Computation Space
step02.description: LLM transitions fire in the Computation space — consuming your input token, calling AI models, executing tools, and producing a structured draft.
step02.cpnLabel: Transition fires, LLM produces output tokens

step03.title: You review and decide
step03.subtitle: HITL Transition: Space Bridge
step03.description: The Human-in-the-Loop transition pauses the net and presents the draft. You approve, reject, or request revisions — your voice crosses from Surface to Computation.

step04.title: Result delivered
step04.subtitle: Place: Output
step04.description: The approved result lands in the Output place — auditable, cost-tracked, and ready. Every step recorded for future optimization.
step04.cpnLabel: Token deposited in Output Place, execution logged

cpnEngine.title: Agentic CPN Engine
cpnEngine.description: Coloured Petri Net orchestration provides deterministic, concurrent AI workflows. Every execution follows a mathematically verified topology.

hitl.title: Human in the Loop
hitl.description: Approval and revision loops at critical decision points. AI proposes, humans decide — with multi-round revision when needed.

personality.title: Agent Personality
personality.description: Configure your AI's principles: nucleo, conducta, etica. Define tension rules and hierarchies that shape every response.

monitoring.title: Live Monitoring
monitoring.description: Real-time SSE-powered execution visualization. Watch tokens flow, transitions fire, and costs accumulate — live.

tools.title: Tool Ecosystem
tools.description: MCP-standard tool integration. Connect databases, APIs, file systems, and custom tools into your AI workflows.

flowIntelligence.title: Flow Intelligence
flowIntelligence.description: Topologies crystallize, rank, and optimize over time. The more you use a workflow, the better it gets — measured by real execution data.

mission.title: Technology as a <accent>seed of justice</accent>
mission.description: We bring technology to the field as a tool to sow opportunities, strengthen community knowledge, and care for the land while growing together. We create and teach technology made with communities, so that rural people can live well, pursue their ideas, and defend their right to stay on their land with pride, dignity, and progress.
mission.quote: "We imagine a territory where learning technology is as common as farming, and where our communities are leaders of a new rurality — prosperous, creative, and just."

humanFirst.title: Human First
humanFirst.description: Technology at the service of people, not the other way around.

territorialKnowledge.title: Territorial Knowledge
territorialKnowledge.description: We value traditional wisdom and build from it, not over it.

positiveImpact.title: Positive Impact
positiveImpact.description: Tech solutions that improve lives, care for the planet, and generate income.

coCreation.title: Co-creation
coCreation.description: Everything built in dialogue with people and communities.

techSovereignty.title: Tech Sovereignty
techSovereignty.description: Supporting autonomy to cultivate and to create your own technology.

socialJustice.title: Social Justice
socialJustice.description: Businesses that reduce inequalities, not deepen them.

footerCta.title: Ready to see AI <accent>you can trust</accent>?
footerCta.description: We work directly with each partner to build AI workflows tailored to your needs. No black boxes. No surprises.

footer.brandDescription: Technology as a seed of justice, empowerment, and abundance for rural communities. Built with communities, for communities.
